tasks.short: Identify maintenance needs and notify staff

steps.what: Determine facility maintenance and repair needs from inspection and resident reports
Notify appropriate personnel with the location and observed repair need

tasks.design: Use the existing {HELPDESK} maintenance form to route a checked need instead of retyping messages and finding contacts. Keep inspection, urgency judgement and final notification checking with the advisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Maintenance details and contact selection may be repeated in separate messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ticket forms can retain location and route by an approved maintenance category.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong location or urgency can delay the response.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise the real problem and use urgent escalation where needed.
tasks.altitude: Less notification preparation, with observation and urgency decisions unchanged.

reach.learn: Required report details and urgent escalation channels

evidence.claim: A native maintenance form can reduce repeated notification entry; the digest supplies no measured residential-advisor result.

assumptions: Boundary is need determination and notification, excluding maintenance diagnosis, repair and scheduling.

Test native helpdesk configuration first; no automated safety classification is used.

Complete missing fields and check the notification

tasks.short: Develop and coordinate resident education programs

steps.what: Develop educational programs suited to resident interests and needs
Coordinate program dates, rooms and contributors and confirm the arrangements

tasks.design: Retain program development with residents and use native shared {CALENDAR} booking for logistics. The advisor checks room suitability and contributor confirmation before accepting arrangements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated availability messages can slow program coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared calendars and standard booking requests can reuse program requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Available time does not guarantee an appropriate space or useful program.
tasks.human_edge: Understand resident needs and confirm the practical fit.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated logistics coordination, with program development unchanged.

reach.learn: Program logistics and resident access needs

evidence.claim: Shared-calendar coordination may reduce repeated availability messages; the proposed saving is model knowledge rather than a measured digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is program development and logistics, excluding teaching delivery and residents' attendance time.
